about_the_game:
Räv Kafé SoundTracks Vol. I

is a calm, Lo-Fi inspired album created by Mr. Wincent Fox, capturing the cozy atmosphere of the fox café from the Räv Kafé world. Each track blends gentle melodies, soft ambience and nostalgic textures — perfect for studying, creating, or relaxing late at night.

This first volume includes ten original instrumental tracks composed under the FoxMask® Studios label, offering an introspective soundscape that mirrors the warmth and melancholy of a quiet evening among coffee cups and autumn leaves.
